headline: Run 1's nine findings are fixed and hold up: every one re-checked passes, and seven of nine probes went red. Two Majors remain, both about guards rather than the app: the slice's 48 px test never measures the tab bar, and the hygiene check lets a denylisted string through in a commit message.

suites.e2e: slice 68/68 pass; QA 76 specs, 74 pass (2 fail: findings 5, 6)

findings.title: The slice's 48 px test never measures the tab bar: tabs shrunk to 40 px leave all 66 preview tests green
findings.detail: Done-when 2 asks for "a test [that] checks every interactive element is at least 48 px". `apps/web/e2e/gallery.spec.ts` measures only `/dev/gallery`, and the gallery isn't in the screen registry, so `showsTabBar` is false there and the tab bar, the most-tapped control in the app, is never measured. The frame spec checks the tab bar's icons and `aria-current`, not its size. Today the tabs are 56–59 × 80 px in all six looks (QA's `b01-run2.spec.ts` measures them), so the behaviour is right; the suite that CI runs just wouldn't notice a regression. QA's own specs in `qa/e2e/` aren't run by CI.
findings.repro: In apps/web/src/styles/frame.css change `.tab { … min-height: 56px; }` to `min-height: 0; height: 40px; overflow: hidden;`, then `cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright test --project preview`.

findings.title: The hygiene check passes a denylisted string in a commit message, a binary file or a UTF-16 file
findings.detail: Spec §17: *No real cap, employer name, ESS address or scheme figure goes in code, fixtures, commits or this spec*, and the PR check *fails … on any string from a private denylist*. `scripts/hygiene.mjs` greps file contents with `git grep -I` (binary files skipped) and reads paths, but never reads commit messages, and a UTF-16 file reads as binary. A session writing "Fix the claim for <employer> travel" as a commit message publishes it, and the check says *Hygiene check passed.* Silent failure is the worst bug (§4 principle 5). Also a screenshot or PDF with the string in its metadata or text layer passes.

findings.title: The no-float lint bans names, not routes: twelve common float paths pass it
findings.detail: The rule bans `parseFloat`, `Number.parseFloat`, `toFixed`, `toPrecision`, `Number()`, unary `+` and `parseInt` by name. These pass lint in both `apps/web/src/blocks/rows.tsx` and `packages/core/src/money.ts`: `Number.parseInt`, `window.parseFloat`, `globalThis.parseFloat`, `globalThis.Number()`, `new Number()`, `el.valueAsNumber`, `JSON.parse(t)`, `sen / 100` in a template, `Intl.NumberFormat(…).format(sen / 100)`, `(sen / 100).toLocaleString()`, `Math.round(rm * 100)`. No current source uses any of them (grep of apps/web/src, packages/core/src, packages/looks/src: only `money.ts`'s own integer division, a chart's percentage, and the looks' SVG geometry). The brief's letter (parseFloat, Number(…), toFixed) is met; CLAUDE.md's *0.1 + 0.2 must be impossible anywhere money flows* is not guarded. Cheapest fix: also ban `MemberExpression[property.name=/^(parseFloat|parseInt|valueAsNumber|toLocaleString)$/]`, `NewExpression[callee.name='Number']`, `Intl.NumberFormat`, and `BinaryExpression[operator='/'][right.value=100]` outside `money.ts`, each with a planted case in `scripts/no-float.test.mjs`.
findings.repro: node a script that calls `new ESLint().lintText(code, { filePath: 'apps/web/src/blocks/rows.tsx' })` for each snippet (QA's script: /tmp/claude-0/qa/lintprobe.mjs, copied to the repo root to run, then removed).

findings.title: The shared error state is drawn in `destructive` red
findings.detail: `ErrorState` (blocks/states.tsx) is shadcn's `Alert variant="destructive"`: its title, icon and border take `--destructive` (lab(40.2 56.7 45.0) in Minted light), and so does every screen's error and the new lost page. patterns.md §2: *`destructive` is for actions that remove something, never for an amount.* An error isn't a removal; §7 asks for *what happened and what to do next, in plain words*. Either use `foreground` with the warning icon (or `money-warning`, always with words), or amend §2 to allow it, since every later screen inherits this.
findings.repro: Open http://localhost:4173/nowhere?look=minted&mode=light; compare getComputedStyle(alert).color with var(--destructive). QA spec: qa/e2e/b01-run2.spec.ts › patterns.md §2: the error state is not drawn in the destructive colour.

findings.title: The gallery's Review row clears on two of its three answers with no Undo
findings.detail: patterns.md §7: *Answering clears it with Undo.* In `/dev/gallery`, *Meals* clears the row and toasts with Undo; *Drinks & desserts* and *Groceries* clear it silently, so the gallery, which B03/B04 copy, shows the pattern broken. `ReviewRow` leaves the Undo to each caller; making the block own the clear-and-toast would keep later screens from repeating this.

findings.title: Some targets sit closer than 8 px; and patterns.md §8 contradicts contiguous rows
findings.detail: patterns.md §8: *Touch targets at least 48 px, 8 px apart.* In the gallery, the section links are 4 px apart vertically, and the *Appearance* settings row sits 5 px from the next row's switch. List rows and the detail page's action rows touch (1 px separator), which §7 designs on purpose (whole-row targets), so §8 needs a line saying contiguous full-width rows are exempt; that's a spec bug to fix in patterns.md. The tab bar is fine.

findings.title: A *Final* status card uses `money-in` green
findings.detail: `StatusCard`'s `done` tone is `text-money-in`, and `waiting` is `text-money-pending`. patterns.md §3: *The money colours mean the same in every look … Green means money in, everywhere.* A split's *Final* or *Everyone has paid* in money-in green says "money in" by colour. The words are there, so it's not colour-only, but the money tokens get a second meaning that every later status card inherits. Use `icon`/`foreground` for done, or add status tokens to patterns.md §2.
findings.repro: Open /dev/gallery → Status cards: *Final* (Lunch pool, week 41). Source: apps/web/src/blocks/status.tsx `tone`.

findings.detail: The large figure for *Over by RM215.40* in Copper is green, as its design intends (struck verdigris), against patterns.md §3's *green means money in, everywhere*. The label says *Over by* with the warning icon in amber, so it isn't colour-only. Still open with the owner in the handoff; recorded so it isn't lost.

findings.title: Hygiene drops a denylist term under 3 characters, then says the secret is not set
findings.detail: `terms()` filters out strings shorter than 3 characters. With `DENYLIST` holding only such a term, the log says *The DENYLIST secret is not set, so the denylist part was skipped*, which is false and would mislead whoever reads the CI log. Say how many terms were ignored and why.

findings.title: Sheet ids open as bare pages: /s/scan-more and /s/sen show no tab bar and no sheet
findings.detail: The registry gives `scan-more`, `sen` and `cycle` the kind `sheet`, but `/s/<id>` renders them as full pages with neither the tab bar nor the sheet. A stale link would land there. Redirect sheet ids to their parent screen with the sheet open, or to Home.
